discription: A basic pulse wave passed through a resonant low-pass filter whose cutoff frequency sweeps with the ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseWidth=0.5, cutoff=4000, rq=0.5;var sig, env, filterFreq;env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pulseWidth);filterFreq = LinLin.ar(env, 0, 1, 100, cutoff);sig = RLPF.ar(sig, filterFreq, rq);sig = sig * amp * env;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
